name: Torven Slatebough
source_profile:
Elder Torven Slatebough (CN)

A former war leader, Torven is one of the Coalition's most vocal advocates of armed resistance. He regards the Cadorian land rush as an invasion, not a legitimate settlement effort. Having already witnessed the construction of mining camps near Karrathi territory, he believes military resistance is inevitable. Torven is prepared to sacrifice considerable resources to prevent the establishment of permanent Cadorian strongholds in the mountains.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 67 (source excerpt; may be partial)
